title: dispatch-gates: a new FieldSchema key does not derive the driver-sql and metadata-core closure suites, so the local sweep is green and CI is red
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC

Found twice on 2026-11-22 (PR #36449 and PR #36399). Filed by the seat.

## What happens

Adding a key to `FieldSchema` owes two closure rows outside `packages/spec`: `FIELD_KEY_STORAGE_CLASS` in `@objectstack/driver-sql` and `FIELD_REFERENCE_POSITIONS` in `@objectstack/metadata-core`, plus the field-count pin in metadata-protocol. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives none of those packages' suites from a diff that only touches `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts`, so a dev's local sweep is green and CI's Test Core shards go red. Both PRs lost a CI round to it.

## What should happen

A diff that changes `FieldSchema`'s key set derives the two closure suites (and the count pin) the way it derives spec's own, or the closure pins move next to the schema so the spec suite catches them.

## Notes

- See also the memory-recorded class "CI reds a green dispatch-gate sweep misses".
- Shipped source changes in those two packages also owe a changeset entry each (L1 reworks 7079997817 and 7080045587).
